description: Java class implementing a LoRaWAN provider for Firefly, handling message extraction and normalization.

classes.name: FireflyProvider
classes.description: A LoRaWAN provider class for Firefly, implementing methods to extract and normalize message data.

methods.name: extractDeviceId
methods.description: Extracts device EUI from the JSON message.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts payload string from the JSON message.

methods.name: extractMessageType
methods.description: Determines message type, returns UPLINK if confirmed_data_up, otherwise UNKNOWN.

methods.name: extractNormalizedData
methods.description: Normalizes various data fields from the message into a map.

methods.name: extractAdditionalData
methods.description: Returns a copy of the message with certain fields removed, or null.
